request: how long is it from 9:45 to 11:20?

beats.intent: A time line from 9:30 to 11:30 with 9:45 and 11:20 marked
beats.narration: A train leaves at quarter to ten and arrives at twenty past eleven. How long is the journey?
beats.code:
stage.title("From 9:45 to 11:20")
tx = lambda m: -5.5 + m * 11 / 120
line = Line([tx(0), -0.6, 0], [tx(120), -0.6, 0], color=GREY_B)
ticks = VGroup(*[Line([tx(m), -0.75, 0], [tx(m), -0.45, 0], color=GREY_B) for m in (15, 30, 90, 110)])
stage.play(Create(line), Create(ticks))
stage.add(line, ticks)
for m, lab, col in ((15, "9:45", RED), (30, "10:00", WHITE), (90, "11:00", WHITE), (110, "11:20", RED)):
    stage.add(Text(lab, font_size=26, color=col).move_to([tx(m), -1.1, 0]))
start = Dot([tx(15), -0.6, 0], color=RED)
end = Dot([tx(110), -0.6, 0], color=RED)
stage.play(FadeIn(start), FadeIn(end))
stage.add(start, end)

beats.intent: A hop from 9:45 to 10:00 labelled 15 min
beats.narration: Count up to the next whole hour first: from nine forty five to ten is fifteen minutes.
beats.code:
hop1 = ArcBetweenPoints([tx(15), -0.6, 0], [tx(30), -0.6, 0], angle=-PI / 2, color=YELLOW)
stage.play(Create(hop1))
stage.add(hop1)
stage.label(hop1, "15 min", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: A hop from 10:00 to 11:00 labelled 1 h, then 11:00 to 11:20 labelled 20 min
beats.narration: Then a whole hour to eleven, and twenty more minutes to twenty past.
beats.code:
hop2 = ArcBetweenPoints([tx(30), -0.6, 0], [tx(90), -0.6, 0], angle=-PI / 2, color=GREEN)
stage.play(Create(hop2))
stage.add(hop2)
stage.label(hop2, "1 h", direction=UP, color=GREEN)
hop3 = ArcBetweenPoints([tx(90), -0.6, 0], [tx(110), -0.6, 0], angle=-PI / 2, color=BLUE)
stage.play(Create(hop3))
stage.add(hop3)
stage.label(hop3, "20 min", direction=UP, color=BLUE)

beats.intent: The time line beside 15 + 60 + 20 = 95 min = 1 h 35 min
beats.narration: Fifteen plus sixty plus twenty is ninety five minutes: one hour thirty five.

request: why is your shadow shortest around midday?

beats.intent: A 1.7 m person with a low morning sun at 30°, a long 2.94 m shadow
beats.narration: In the morning the sun is low, about thirty degrees up. A person one point seven metres tall casts a long shadow.
beats.code:
stage.title("Shadows and the sun")
ground = Line([-6.5, -2, 0], [5.5, -2, 0], color=GREY_B)
person = Line([-1, -2, 0], [-1, -0.3, 0], color=WHITE, stroke_width=8)
stage.play(Create(ground), Create(person))
stage.add(ground, person)
tip = np.array([-1 - 1.7 / np.tan(30 * DEGREES), -2, 0])
sun = Dot(tip + 7 * np.array([np.cos(30 * DEGREES), np.sin(30 * DEGREES), 0]), radius=0.3, color=YELLOW)
ray = DashedLine(sun.get_center(), tip, color=YELLOW)
shadow = Line(tip, [-1, -2, 0], color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=10)
stage.play(FadeIn(sun), Create(ray))
stage.play(Create(shadow))
stage.add(sun, ray, shadow)
sh_lab = stage.label(shadow, "2.94 m", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: The sun climbing to 60°, the shadow shrinking to 0.98 m
beats.narration: By midday the sun is much higher, about sixty degrees, and the shadow shrinks to under a metre.
beats.code:
stage.play(FadeOut(sh_lab))
tip2 = np.array([-1 - 1.7 / np.tan(60 * DEGREES), -2, 0])
sun2 = tip2 + 5 * np.array([np.cos(60 * DEGREES), np.sin(60 * DEGREES), 0])
stage.play(sun.animate.move_to(sun2), Transform(ray, DashedLine(sun2, tip2, color=YELLOW)), Transform(shadow, Line(tip2, [-1, -2, 0], color=BLUE_D, stroke_width=10)), run_time=1.5)
stage.add(sun, ray, shadow)
stage.label(shadow, "0.98 m", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: The right triangle of person, shadow and ray, the 60° angle marked at the shadow's tip
beats.narration: The person, the shadow and the sun's ray make a right angled triangle. The sun's height is the angle at the tip of the shadow.
beats.code:
ang = Angle(Line(tip2, tip2 + RIGHT), Line(tip2, sun2), radius=0.6, color=GREEN)
stage.play(Create(ang))
stage.add(ang)
stage.label(ang, "60°", direction=LEFT, color=GREEN)
stage.label(person, "1.7 m", direction=RIGHT)

beats.intent: The picture beside shadow = 1.7 / tan 30° ≈ 2.94 and 1.7 / tan 60° ≈ 0.98
beats.narration: Shadow length is height divided by the tangent of the sun's angle. A higher sun has a bigger tangent, so a shorter shadow.

request: how much paint do I need for a wall with a window in it?

beats.intent: A 4 m by 2.5 m wall with its sides labelled
beats.narration: A wall is four metres wide and two and a half metres high.
beats.code:
stage.title("Painting a wall")
k = 1.2
wall = Rectangle(width=4 * k, height=2.5 * k, color=WHITE).move_to([-2.5, -0.4, 0])
stage.play(Create(wall))
stage.add(wall)
stage.label(Line(wall.get_corner(DL), wall.get_corner(DR)), "4 m", direction=DOWN)
stage.label(Line(wall.get_corner(DL), wall.get_corner(UL)), "2.5 m", direction=LEFT)

beats.intent: A 1.5 m by 1 m window inside the wall
beats.narration: It has a window one and a half metres by one metre, which you don't paint.
beats.code:
window = Rectangle(width=1.5 * k, height=1 * k, color=BLUE_B, fill_color=BLACK, fill_opacity=1).move_to([-2.0, -0.1, 0])
cross = VGroup(Line(window.get_top(), window.get_bottom()), Line(window.get_left(), window.get_right())).set_stroke(BLUE_B, 2)
stage.play(Create(window), Create(cross))
stage.add(window, cross)
stage.label(window, "1.5 m × 1 m", direction=UP, color=BLUE_B)

beats.intent: The wall shaded around the window: 10 − 1.5 = 8.5 m²
beats.narration: The wall is ten square metres; take away the window's one and a half, and there's eight and a half to paint.
beats.code:
stage.play(wall.animate.set_fill(ORANGE, opacity=0.5))
stage.remove(window, cross)
stage.add(window, cross)
stage.label(wall, "10 − 1.5 = 8.5 m²", direction=RIGHT, color=ORANGE)

beats.intent: The wall beside 2 × 8.5 = 17 m² and 17 ÷ 10 = 1.7 litres
beats.narration: Two coats make seventeen square metres. If a litre covers ten square metres, you need one point seven litres.

request: what does a map scale of 1:25,000 mean?

beats.intent: A map with two places, A and B, and a ruler showing them 4 cm apart
beats.narration: On a map, a church and a bridge are four centimetres apart.
beats.code:
stage.title("A 1:25,000 map")
paper = Rectangle(width=7, height=3.6, color=GREEN_E, fill_opacity=0.25).move_to([-2.5, 0.2, 0])
road = DashedLine([-5.6, 0.9, 0], [0.6, 0.9, 0], color=GREY_B)
a = Dot([-4.5, 0.9, 0], color=RED)
b = Dot([-0.5, 0.9, 0], color=RED)
stage.play(FadeIn(paper), Create(road), FadeIn(a), FadeIn(b))
stage.add(paper, road, a, b)
stage.label(a, "A", direction=UP, color=RED)
stage.label(b, "B", direction=UP, color=RED)
ruler = VGroup(Line([-4.5, -0.6, 0], [-0.5, -0.6, 0]), *[Line([-4.5 + i, -0.75, 0], [-4.5 + i, -0.45, 0]) for i in range(5)])
nums = VGroup(*[Text(f"{i}", font_size=22).move_to([-4.5 + i, -1.0, 0]) for i in range(5)])
stage.play(Create(ruler), FadeIn(nums))
stage.add(ruler, nums)
stage.add(Text("cm", font_size=22).next_to(nums, RIGHT, buff=0.2))

beats.intent: The first centimetre highlighted: 1 cm on the map is 25,000 cm = 250 m on the ground
beats.narration: One to twenty five thousand means each centimetre on the map is twenty five thousand centimetres on the ground: two hundred and fifty metres.
beats.code:
one = Line([-4.5, -0.6, 0], [-3.5, -0.6, 0], color=YELLOW, stroke_width=8)
stage.play(Create(one))
stage.add(one)
stage.label(one, "1 cm = 250 m", direction=UP, color=YELLOW)

beats.intent: All four centimetres highlighted: 4 cm on the map is 1 km
beats.narration: Four centimetres is four lots of two hundred and fifty metres: one kilometre.
beats.code:
four = Line([-4.5, 0.9, 0], [-0.5, 0.9, 0], color=ORANGE, stroke_width=8)
stage.play(Create(four))
stage.add(four)
stage.label(four, "4 cm = 1 km", direction=DOWN, color=ORANGE)

beats.narration: Multiply by the scale, then convert: a hundred thousand centimetres is a thousand metres, one kilometre.
